public.text: Inclusive representation is framed around rural populations, women, displaced persons, and under-resourced systems. Other groups at risk of exclusion, including persons with disabilities, linguistic minorities, Indigenous communities, children, older people, people without legal identity, and digitally excluded populations, are not explicitly recognised.
public.suggestedRevision: Broaden the examples and require each country to identify affected and underrepresented groups through a contextual equity and human-rights assessment rather than relying on a fixed list.
